findings.evidence: This draft is owned by current-run batch 17. The operationwise arithmetic model defines scalar primitives, not a dot-product primitive. Assigned consumer `alg-pade-denominator-solve-by-householder-qr` requires a before-operation budget dispatcher and claims a fully funded execution matches the source trace; those properties cannot be determined without the missing operation order. The supplier needs explicit finite loops and real-component operation order. The source bytes were not bound to a raw hash or immutable pre-reader snapshot.
